scientific_integrity: The published Lucas-digit and Apéry results are cited explicitly; the additional digit lemma and perfectness conclusion are proved in the result. No independent audit was conducted.
scientific_limitations: Classification concerns the Lucas-shift family containing the unshifted Lucas term \(L_a\), not the shifted-only family.
Bibliographic priority beyond the inspected evidence is not certified.
Finite verification does not independently prove the published Apéry theorem.
title: Perfectness of every positive-index Lucas-shift numerical semigroup
